    //==
    // # Collections grids
    //
    // Derived functionality for the multi-dimensional IIndexable interfaces
    // (`collections.concepts.plato`): bounds checks, corner-cell access,
    // and the row-major flat-index conversions
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Row-_and_column-major_order) for 2D grids, 3D
    // volumes and 4D hypervolumes.

    //==
    // # IIndexable2D
    //
    // Cell access, bounds checks, and row-major flat-index conversions for a
    // column x row grid.

    // True when (column, row) lies within the grid.
    IsValidCell(self: IIndexable2D<$T>, column: Integer, row: Integer): Boolean
        => column >= 0 && column < self.ColumnCount
        && row >= 0 && row < self.RowCount;
```

    //==
    // # IIndexable3D
    //
    // Cell access and bounds checks for a column x row x layer volume.

    // True when (column, row, layer) lies within the volume.
    IsValidCell(self: IIndexable3D<$T>, column: Integer, row: Integer, layer: Integer): Boolean
        => column >= 0 && column < self.ColumnCount
        && row >= 0 && row < self.RowCount
        && layer >= 0 && layer < self.LayerCount;
```
